verdict.rationale: Retell's docs describe per-agent configurable data retention with automatic, permanent deletion of call/chat transcripts, recordings, and logs after a set period (retell-docs-15, retell-docs-27, retell-docs-44), which is solid first-party evidence for the retention-control axis. However, an independent community report describes the company refusing to delete a user's stored data (credit card) on request, forcing the user to escalate to bank disputes/consumer-affairs complaints — a concrete real-world case where deletion did not work as a customer expected (retell-comm-14). Missing for 10: independent verification that call/chat data deletion itself (not just billing data) works as documented, and no public response/resolution to the deletion complaint.
